question: trace the F1 stream to name the operation, and check whether the in-body clear regions of its selectors are the scalar form of the same operation

operation.name: lowercase hexadecimal encoding
operation.contract: out[2*i] = table[in[i] >> 4], out[2*i+1] = table[in[i] & 0xf] for table = "0123456789abcdef"; input rdi, length rsi, output rdx; no return value
evidence: the body's only external references are a 16x0x0f nibble mask and the 16-byte ASCII table "0123456789abcdef" in .rodata
the vector loop splits each 16-byte block into nibbles, shuffles both nibble planes through the table with pshufb, interleaves the characters and stores 32 bytes per 16 input bytes
the in-body scalar tail converts the remaining length & 0xf bytes with the same table, hi nibble first, storing at twice the input index
